description:
Hybrid keyword + semantic search over the public pages of vascue.io: healthcare-operations guides, Vascue Front Desk for clinics, provider-side insurance-claims automation, practice-management integrations (two-way sync with Cliniko and Nookal; Jane, Mindbody, PracticeHub, HexaHealth, Halaxy, Clinicea, ClinicOffice, Semble, Plato Medical and JERA in progress), security and compliance pages, case studies, pricing and blog posts.

Use it to answer questions about what Vascue offers, how its products work and what it has published. One topic per call; cite the returned page URL for every excerpt you use.

Returns a JSON text payload: result.chunks[] ordered by relevance, each with text (a Markdown excerpt), score (0-1, higher is better) and item.metadata.url (the canonical https://www.vascue.io/... page). Off-topic queries still return the nearest chunks, so treat scores below about 0.5 as weak evidence and say so when the site does not cover a topic.

Read-only and idempotent; no authentication; 60 requests per minute per client. Public content only: never send patient information, claim documents, clinic credentials or booking requests. It cannot book appointments or look up clinic data.

ai_search_options.description: Optional retrieval tuning. Omit for the defaults: hybrid search, 8 results, score threshold 0.35.

context_expansion.description: Neighbouring chunks from the same page to include around each hit (default 0).

match_threshold.description: Minimum relevance score for a chunk to be included (default 0.35); raise for precision, lower for recall.

retrieval_type.description: hybrid (default) fuses keyword and vector ranking; keyword for exact phrases or product names; vector for paraphrased questions.

query.description: What to look for, as a natural-language question or keywords, e.g. "how does claims pre-authorisation work" or "Cliniko integration". 3-15 words works best; one topic per call.

name: search
title: Search Vascue's public documentation
